documents.text: Regarding your upcoming trip, please note that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. For arrival, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. While a swimming area is mentioned, its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated in our current file. On activities, the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. We advise confirming the pool details directly with the property, as those specifics remain undefined in this package. Your guide fee is fully covered by the initial quote, ensuring a seamless hiking experience without hidden costs.

Q: What happens if I cancel? A: Neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. Q: Can I arrive at 01:30? A: Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. Q: Is the pool free? A: The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Q: Is the hike included? A: The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Please note that the Selected offer is Alder. The Distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer.

Dear Guest, regarding your selected terms, please be advised that before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. These current selected terms completely replace the old policy, which contained no rules addressing overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. We look forward to your stay.
